property_summary: For every admissible Collect call that succeeds, the caller's balance must equal the pre-call balance minus the collected amount, which the bug violates because it moves the decrement after the external call so a re-entrant Collect observes an unchanged balance and can withdraw more than the caller was entitled to.
change_summary: Move the balance decrement from before the external call to after the call and its success check, so re-entrant Collect calls observe the unchanged balance.
